resources.string: Erases the device and installs the latest AGNOS + openpilot release.

1. Unplug the device and wait for the light on the back to turn off.
2. Connect port 1 to this phone (USB-C OTG adapter recommended).
3. Connect port 2 to a power brick.

The screen stays blank in EDL mode; that's normal.
